items.q: Where does he say aura actually comes from?
items.a: How you handle fear. The lion, Tommy Shelby, and Don Draper broadcast the same thing: **totally safe under threat**. A speedboat pose is the internet's version.

Size gets you noticed. A **6'5 friend still hunched** and hid his hands. McConaughey takes his time instead. **Rushing means the aura is off.** Slow down, pause, open the vitals, and give the body about **90 seconds**.
Shame. He says you are **safe to be seen 99.99%** of the time, and the old danger response is miscalibrated to a night out.

items.q: How did two broke guys skip the line later?
items.a: They **thanked the doorman and learned his name** on the way out. Next time he lifted the rope. Same move: gym desk, cleaning crew, barista. **Stay in the conversation** instead of scanning the room.

items.q: What did the boat dance and the plain-shirt shooter have in common?
items.a: The look was the leftover of reps. Ryan's dance was his job at a **300-year festival**. The 2024 shooter won **silver in a t-shirt**. Confidence is who you are after the reps, including the reps where you **fall short and still thrive**.
